name: Ms. Rivers
source:
A professor from your old university with whom [url=/c148150]you[/url] became involved during a difficult period of your life. You once thought you had fallen for her. Looking back, you describe what happened as a matter of convenience, and the way it ended still makes the memory uncomfortable.
